generalComment.value: This EPD is based on the life cycle assessment of the wire rod from RIVA Stahl GmbH, which is produced in the rolling mill of Brandenburger Elektrostahlwerke GmbH (BES). The declaration holder is liable for the underlying information and evidence. Kiwa-Ecobility Experts assumes no liability for manufacturer's information, LCA data and evidence.

description.value: The waste scenario for reinforcing steel "Steel, reinforcement" was assigned to the raw materials both for waste during production and at the end of product life. The waste scenario is based on the "Nationale Milieudatabase" (NMD), the national environmental database of the Netherlands. This is due to the fact that the online EPD tool used, "R< THiNK", was developed by Nibe in the Netherlands. The waste scenario used for reinforcing steel has the NMD ID 49. Further information is listed in Chapter 4 below. The "no waste" waste scenario (NMD ID 15) is used for auxiliary materials, as the waste generated is already taken into account elsewhere, for example through production emissions.

timeRepresentativenessDescription.value: All product and process-specific data was collected for the 2018 operating year and is therefore up to date.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: The product to be declared is wire rod from RIVA Stahl GmbH, which is produced in the rolling mill of Brandenburger Elektrostahlwerke GmbH (BES). Wire rod is produced by hot rolling billets on special continuous rolling mills, which formed it into rings and used as a semi-finished product. Billets are semi-finished products with a square cross-section and rounded edges that are produced using the continuous casting process. They are used as input material for the hot rolling process or are processed directly into forgings.

technologicalApplicability.value: Für Walzdraht gibt es unter anderem folgende Anwendungsbereiche: Industriedraht, Reifendraht, Hebeseile, Spannbetonseile, beschichteter Elektrodendraht, Schweißdraht, Federdraht, Ketten, Schrauben, Metallkleinteile, Metallgitter und Nägel.

Wire rod is used, among other things, as industrial wire, tire wire, lifting ropes, prestressed concrete ropes, coated electrode wire, welding wire, spring wire, chains, screws, small metal parts, metal mesh and nails.

useAdviceForDataSet.value: Wire rod is used, among other things, as industrial wire, tire wire, lifting ropes, prestressed concrete ropes, coated electrode wire, welding wire, spring wire, chains, screws, small metal parts, metal mesh and nails.
